svg.text: ▸ D1 is a reverse-polarity SHUNT: it only conducts if the
supply is backwards, then F1 trips. Unplug to reset it.
Female-female Dupont jumpers into the R32's own
header sockets: nothing is soldered to the R32.
Pins with no job at boot only. Not used:
D4, D5 labels differ between R32 makers
D7, D10 pulse at boot (GPIO14, GPIO5)
D8, A0 boot strapping pins (GPIO12, GPIO2)
USB and 12 V together are fine (D2 blocks
both ways). First upload: the R32 alone.
Pin map and jumper list: sheet 2.
LED STRIP IN THE LAMP · 12 V, COMMON +
▸ R4–R6 pull the gates low: the strip stays dark while the ESP32
starts, resets or is unplugged. 5 kHz PWM, 12-bit, gamma 2.2.
▸ 3.3 V gate drive: logic-level MOSFETs only (IRLZ44N, IRLB8721).
IRF520 / IRF540 need 10 V on the gate and will stay half on.
D — FRONT PANEL: IR, BUTTON, STATUS LIGHT
1. U1 drops 7 V at about 0.15 A ≈ 1 W: fit the heatsink, vent the box.
2. D2 stops USB feeding back into U1: the R32 gets about 4.7 V.
3. U2 runs from the R32's 3.3 V so its output is ESP32-safe;
R7/C5 filter its supply (datasheet), R8 pulls OUT high.
4. Strip current returns on its own 0 V bus straight to T1.
5. All resistors 1/4 W 5 %. F1 hold 2.5 A, 30 V or more.
6. Dashed amber lines are leads and jumpers, not board wiring.
J1 centre pin → T1 → F1 (before the fuse)
+12 V after F1: strip +, 7805 input, D1 shunt, C1
0 V. Strip return on the top bus, logic on the lower buses
after D2 → J3-3 → R32 5V pin (about 4.7 V)
R32 3V3 pin → J3-6: IR receiver supply and pull-up
IR receiver supply after the R7/C5 filter
R1 → Q1 gate, R4 to 0 V
R2 → Q2 gate, R5 to 0 V
R3 → Q3 gate, R6 to 0 V
D12 (GPIO19) → J3-1 → J5 → SW1 to 0 V
ESP32 (D1 R32) · 12 V RGB STRIP DRIVER
